newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Van Miert sees no quick decision on BA-AMR pact.
newsitem.headline: Van Miert sees no quick decision on BA-AMR pact.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said Tuesday that the European Commission was unlikely to rule on the planned alliance between British Airways and American Airlines before the end of August.
"This is certainly going beyond the summer break," Van Miert said in replying to questions about a meeting he had Monday with BA Chairman Robert Ayling.
Van Miert said the talks had been constructive.

He said, however, the commission, the European Union's executive body, would have to consult a committee of national competition officials twice on the alliance and, therefore, a final recommendation was unlikely to be adopted before the commission broke for its summer recess in August.
American Airlines is a unit of AMR Corp., which is based at the Dallas-Fort Worth Airport in Texas.
